title: RWB-S9-E7014-APP: no source owns the partner notice in S9, publishes a notice, target or cure-period property, or gives the notice a message; no partner route set exists, and no requirement row traces to FEAT-PRM-11
source: Template and Rules v1 R4, R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E7014-APP; context pack S9 rwb-partner (service row, ownership rows: tables partner, partner_instruction and partner_user, 6 REST operations, EV-20 and EV-21, workflow InstructionWorkflow, no job; Architecture v5 slides 2, 4, 5, 8 and 12); legacy RWB-E7-014; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A1.2, A1.3, A2.11, A2.11.2, A2.11.3.1 to A2.11.3.3 and A2.11.4; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T1, T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T8 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules sheet; Event and Messaging Design v4 events EV-13, EV-14, EV-20 and EV-21; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-PRM-11
description: (1) The legacy feature sends a contractual notice and the legacy Data table lists the notice row with DF-LEG-015 to DF-LEG-023, but no source owns a notice in S9: TSD S9 T3.1 gives the service partner, partner_instruction and partner_user only, FSD S9 T5.2 sends notices to P6, and the event catalogue gives NoticeGenerated and NoticeDispatched to Communications, so the notice is read as a rwb-comms element requested on its contract (ASM-B2-S9-012-1). (2) The legacy endpoint table names POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions and GET /partner/instructions for a notice and no source publishes a notice path, a notice property or a notice type value for a partner, so the act is submitted on the instruction operation and the notice-carrying property carries the placeholder (ASM-B2-S9-012-4). (3) No partner route set exists in the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4: there is no R-PRM row, the nearest rows are R-UNI-25 to R-UNI-29 for a missed service level, a panel exit, a conflict, insolvency and a conduct breach, and R-RES-27 to R-RES-29 carry a cure period for a broken treatment plan only, so the rule ID and the version the decision record must carry have no row to cite (ASM-B2-S9-012-2). (4) The cure period has no length, no parameter and no list in any source, and cure_period_days belongs to the treatment plan (ASM-B2-S9-012-3). (5) The target has no threshold, no measure and no parameter: partner.score is the latest scorecard result and FEAT-PRM-02 keeps the targets as versioned reference data without publishing a value (ASM-B2-S9-012-10). (6) EV-21 PartnerResultSubmitted is published in TSD S9 T5.3 and consumed in the event catalogue, and the ownership rows give the service both EV-20 and EV-21 (ASM-B2-S9-012-5). (7) The two exits from ON_NOTICE, back to ACTIVE when the cure is met and to SUSPENDED when it lapses, have no trigger, no rule row and no story in any source, and the refusal of a partner off the panel or already on notice has no message (ASM-B2-S9-012-6). (8) TSD S9 T8 maps every REQ-S9 row to FEAT-PRM-01 or FEAT-PRM-08 and no row names FEAT-PRM-11, so the story cites no requirement ID (ASM-B2-S9-012-9).
evidence: TSD S9 T3.1 (three tables, no notice, no target, no cure period), T3.2 (LOV-PANEL ACTIVE, ON_NOTICE, SUSPENDED, EXITED), T5.2 (notices through P6), T5.3 (InstructionIssued and PartnerResultSubmitted), T6.1 (Partner portal column), T-A.1 and T-A.2 (six operations, none for a notice); FSD S9 A1.2 row FEAT-PRM-11, A2.11.3.1 (VR-S9-011-1 and BR-S9-011 only), A2.11.3.2 (eight fields, none for a target or a cure period), A2.11.4.4 (no background event) and the Screens table; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules sheet (no R-PRM rows; R-UNI-25 to R-UNI-29; R-RES-27 to R-RES-29); Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-13, EV-14, EV-20 and EV-21 and the Events sheet note that EV-21 is consumed; legacy RWB-E7-014 Data, Endpoints and Validation tables
owner_role: Business lead; solution architect; rwb-comms owner; rwb-case reference-data owner; rwb-decision rule owner
proposed: Read the contractual notice as a rwb-comms element requested on its contract with a fake, keep the panel change on partner.panel_status at ON_NOTICE, submit the act on API-S9-002 with the Idempotency-Key, write the local decision record before any change with the rule ID and the version where they exist and the placeholder where they do not, hold the target, the cure period, the two exits from ON_NOTICE, the refusal message, the direction of EV-21 and the requirement row as open items with placeholder text.

title: RWB-S9-E7014-CON: the contract has no notice, target or cure-period property or operation, partner_user has no field list, no partner route set exists, the plan's C row is empty while two consumed rows are declared and DP-06 and DP-07 are absent, EV-21 has two directions, and no requirement row traces to FEAT-PRM-11
source: Template and Rules v1 R3, R4, R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.2, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S9-E7014-CON; context pack S9 rwb-partner (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 2, 4, 5, 8 and 12); legacy RWB-E7-014; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A1.2, A2.11.2, A2.11.3.1 to A2.11.3.3, A2.11.4 and the Screens table; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T2, T3.0, T3.1, T3.2, T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2, T8 and T-A.1 to T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 Rules sheet; Event and Messaging Design v4; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-PRM-11 and its endpoint table
description: (1) TSD S9 T-A.2 publishes the request and answer element names, the rights and the error status codes of the six operations, and T-A.1 publishes their first-in epic, but no source publishes a notice path, a notice property, a notice type for a partner, a target property or a cure-period property, so each carries the placeholder and the notice is declared as a consumed row of rwb-comms (ASM-B2-S9-012-1, ASM-B2-S9-012-4). (2) The ownership rows give S9 three tables and TSD S9 T3.1 defines partner and partner_instruction only, so partner_user has no column, no type and no required flag and no property of it may be declared (ASM-B2-S9-012-4). (3) The Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 has no R-PRM route set, so the rule ID and the version the decision-record element carries have no row, no package and no set to declare (ASM-B2-S9-012-2). (4) The target and the cure period are consumed from the reference data of rwb-case by the R3 default ruling, yet the plan's C row is None while the baseline declares two consumed rows, DP-06 and DP-07 are absent from the pattern set of the key, and neither the parameters nor the values are published (ASM-B2-S9-012-3, ASM-B2-S9-012-10). (5) Event and Messaging Design v4 reads EV-21 as consumed and TSD S9 T5.3 lists it as published, and the ownership rows give the service EV-20 and EV-21 together (ASM-B2-S9-012-5). (6) No requirement row traces to FEAT-PRM-11 in TSD S9 T8, and the legacy story names the feature without a REQ id (ASM-B2-S9-012-9). (7) The refusal of a partner off the panel or already on notice is returned by API-S9-002 with a 409 and no message exists for it in any source (ASM-B2-S9-012-6).
evidence: TSD S9 T-A.1 (six operations with access and first-in), T-A.2 (requests, answers, errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422 and 503, Idempotency-Key), T3.1 (partner and partner_instruction only), T3.2 (four lists), T5.2 (notices through P6), T5.3 (InstructionIssued published, PartnerResultSubmitted published), T6.1 (29 identities and their rights), T8 (REQ-S9-001 to -009 mapped to FEAT-PRM-01 and FEAT-PRM-08); FSD S9 A2.11.3.2 (eight fields) and A2.11.2 (integration point: partner portal); Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-20 and EV-21 and the Events sheet note; legacy RWB-E7-014 Endpoints and Data tables; split plan slice RWB-S9-E7014-CON (C empty)
owner_role: Solution architect; rwb-partner tech lead; business lead; rwb-comms owner; rwb-case reference-data owner; rwb-decision rule owner
proposed: Publish the three operation baselines of /api/recovery/partner/v1 with the Partner and PartnerInstruction elements and the four lists, declare the notice of rwb-comms and the reference data of rwb-case as two consumed rows with fakes and placeholders, declare no notice, target or cure-period property and no partner_user property, declare EV-20 published and EV-21 consumed with the conflict recorded, declare no Schedule and no job, and hold the requirement row and the refusal message open.
